priceSnapshot.note: The breakout was real for three hours and then it was not. The US July payrolls print landed at 07:30 COT and was a genuine miss - the economy SHED 23,000 jobs against a consensus near +83,000, the first outright decline in months, with the unemployment rate falling to 4.1% only because the participation rate dropped to 61.4%, a five-year low, and average hourly earnings decelerating to +3.2% year-on-year, the softest since May 2021. That is the dovish outcome the morning report flagged as one side of a two-sided binary, and BTC took it exactly the way you would expect for about three hours: from 65,020 at the morning stamp it ran to 65,388 by 15:00Z, a new high for the week and 178 points above the previous session high. Then it gave all of it back and more. Price is 64,715.4, which is 304.6 points BELOW where the morning session marked it, -0.47% over five hours and forty-eight minutes, and 672.6 points off the 15:00Z high. The give-back was mechanical and it is on the tape. OKX filled $543,344 of LONG liquidations against $37,605 of shorts between 14:01Z and 17:35Z - 122 of the 128 fills are posSide long being sold out - and the density is stacked directly beneath spot: $190,915 in the 64,600-64,649 band, $182,989 in 64,500-64,549, $94,150 in 64,550-64,599. The single largest fill on the tape is 104.17 contracts at 64,523.2, worth $67,205. That is the precise mirror of what the morning session documented six hours earlier, when $1,126,392 of SHORTS were bought back against zero dollars of longs. Both sides of the leveraged book have now been cleared out twice inside one trading day. What matters more than the squeeze is what price failed to hold. It could not settle a 4H bar above the morning's 65,250 add trigger - the 12:00Z 4H bar topped at 65,388 and closed at 64,908.9, 341 points under the level - and it has since lost the 15m EMA20, EMA50 and EMA100 in sequence. The 15m MACD histogram has swung from +26.48 at the morning read to -56.87 and the 15m RSI from 71.22 to 42.42. The 1H histogram peaked at +98.54 on the 15:00Z bar and has decayed for five consecutive bars to +19.91. Session range since the morning snapshot: low 64,519.2 at 17:30Z, high 65,388 at 15:00Z, an 868.8-point band worth 0.61 of a daily ATR. What is still standing: the daily EMA50 at 64,643.16, reclaimed this morning for the first time since 03 Aug, is 72.2 points below spot and has not been closed under. The 4H and daily MACD histograms are still positive at +7.07 and +21.62. This is a failed breakout inside an intact reclaim, not a broken structure - but the burden of proof has moved back to the buyers and the reduce line is now inside one hour's average range.

reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE below $64,650 - UNCHANGED from the level the morning session published, and deliberately so. Price is 64,715.4, which is 65.4 points above this line and well inside the 1H ATR(14) of roughly 221, so it can be tested on the next bar. This desk's own calibration note this morning recorded that it has twice this week abandoned a level immediately before price reached it, so the line does not move down just because price has walked up to it. What the level is: the daily EMA50 sits at 64,643.16 and was reclaimed on this morning's 09:00Z 1H close for the first time since 03 Aug; 64,650 was the morning's add trigger and it fired; and it is the top of the 64,600-64,649 band where $190,915 of longs were force-sold in the last three hours. The reason it takes a 1H CLOSE and not a touch is that the session low is already 64,519.2 - price has been under this line intraday and recovered, so a wick means nothing here and a settled hourly bar means everything. The warnings between spot and the line, in order: the 15m EMA100 at 64,718.85, the 64,683.2 open of the current 15m bar, and the 64,663.3 last long-liquidation print above the shelf. Below 64,650 the next real floor is the 64,519.2 session low, which sits on top of the 15m EMA200 at 64,574.31 and the 1H EMA50 at 64,565.36. HONEST NOTE ON THE MORNING'S STOP: that report recommended a resting stop at 64,620, and price traded to 64,519.2 at 17:30Z, so that stop would have filled. The paper wallet was flat futures and was not exposed, but the level was too tight and this report widens it.

addIf.confirmation: A 4H CLOSE above $65,400. This RAISES the morning's 65,250 trigger by 150 points, and the reason is that 65,250 has now been tested and rejected rather than abandoned. The morning report set the condition as a four-hour bar SETTLING above the level rather than a poke through it, on the argument that the short fuel which carried price there was already spent. That call was exactly right and is the cleanest piece of calibration on the board this week: the 12:00Z 4H bar reached 65,388, 138 points through the trigger, and closed at 64,908.9. So the whole 65,250-65,400 band is now proven supply with a verified rejection in it, not open air. 65,400 clears today's 65,388 high, it clears the 65,333 and 65,322.8 intraday shelves, and above it the realized-liquidation record is empty until 65,423.7, the 24 Jul spike top. A 4H bar settling above 65,400 would mean the payrolls bid survived a full retracement and came back, which is a different and much stronger event than the one that just failed.

decisionBox.changed: Bias steps DOWN from bullish to range-with-a-bearish-tilt, and confidence from 6.2 to 5.8. Four things moved. FIRST, the morning's add trigger did NOT fire and the morning's own reasoning is why it did not: it required a 4H CLOSE above 65,250, price reached 65,388 and the 4H bar closed at 64,908.9. That distinction was written into the morning report explicitly and it saved the desk from buying a top. SECOND, the leveraged book flipped sides again inside six hours. This morning it was $1,126,392 of shorts liquidated against zero longs; this afternoon it is $543,344 of longs liquidated against $37,605 of shorts, with 70.9% of the notional printing inside the 150 points between 64,500 and 64,649 - directly under spot. Two full flushes in opposite directions in one day is a book with no positioning conviction, and it is why this report will not carry a directional confidence above 6. THIRD, the fast timeframes have rolled over cleanly. The 15m MACD histogram is -56.87 against +26.48 this morning, the 15m RSI is 42.42 against 71.22, and price has lost the 15m EMA20 at 64,877.39, the EMA50 at 64,827.16 and is sitting on the EMA100 at 64,718.85. The 1H histogram has fallen for five consecutive bars from +98.54 to +19.91. FOURTH, and this is the finding that decides the tilt, there is a VERIFIED bearish divergence on the 15m: price closed the 15:00Z bar at 65,289.6, a higher close than the 65,078.7 of the 11:45Z bar, while the 15m RSI(14) printed 75.01 against 76.49 - a higher price high on a lower oscillator high. What has NOT changed: the daily EMA50 reclaim at 64,643.16 is intact by 72.2 points, the 4H and daily MACD histograms are still positive at +7.07 and +21.62, ETF flows are confirmed positive for a fourth day at +137.6M on 06 Aug, and the macro backdrop actually IMPROVED - the DXY fell 0.37% to 99.558 on the weak payrolls print after being up 0.31% pre-report, and the US 10-year dropped to 4.659%. The position moves to REDUCE, meaning a partial trim of the long-term core rather than an exit: the morning added at 65,020 and that add is 304.6 points underwater, the breakout it was buying has failed, and raising some cash before the endday session is worth more than defending a 0.47% drawdown. 64,150 remains the level that voids everything.

liquidation.note: Heaviest band of the afternoon and the single most important level on this map: $190,915 of LONG liquidations filled between 64,600 and 64,649, including a 100.02-contract fill at 64,624.2 and a 61.32-contract fill at 64,621.1. It sits 91.2 points below spot and straddles both the daily EMA50 at 64,643.16 and this report's 64,650 reduce line. Flagged magnet:true as the densest verified cluster on the board, with the standing caveat that these are REALIZED fills and not resting orders - the forward pull comes from being a proven high-volume transaction shelf where a very large number of leveraged longs were carried out, not from unfilled book depth.

$182,989 filled between 64,500 and 64,549, of which $176,535 is longs. This band contains the LARGEST single fill on the entire tape - 104.17 contracts at 64,523.2, worth $67,205 - plus 71.76 contracts at 64,504.9 and 43.67 at 64,512.4. The 64,519.2 session low is inside this band, which is what makes it the real floor rather than the round 64,500: price came here at 17:30Z, cleared the stops, and bounced 196 points in fifteen minutes.

$94,150 filled in the 64,550-64,599 band, all longs, with a 45.98-contract fill at 64,578.4 the largest of it. Taken together with the two bands beneath it, $468,054 - 86.1% of the whole afternoon flush - printed inside the 150 points between 64,500 and 64,649. That is an extremely dense shelf immediately under spot and it cuts both ways: it is where demand proved itself, and it is where the leverage that would have defended a deeper break has already been removed.

$57,213 filled between 64,650 and 64,699 including a 62.86-contract fill at 64,696.6. Spot at 64,715.4 is 35.5 points above the top of this band, which is the least comfortable place on the map - directly on the lip of where the cascade accelerated.

$15,335 filled in the 64,700-64,749 stretch, essentially all longs, marking where the afternoon slide began. Only 5.8 points above spot and thin - there is very little transacted volume between here and the 64,782.7 shelf, so a recovery attempt has little to lean on until the 15m EMA50 at 64,827.16.

The only cluster of any size ABOVE spot and it is 470.2 points away: $30,671 of SHORT liquidations filled between 65,125.9 and 65,194.5 at 14:27Z, on the leg up into the 65,388 high. It is the residue of the morning squeeze rather than a fresh event, and because those shorts have already been bought back the band is now a supply shelf, not fuel. A continuation attempt has to get through it before 65,250 even becomes a question.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is DOWN and the asymmetry is stark. $543,344 of longs were force-sold against $37,605 of shorts, a 14.4-to-1 ratio, and 86.1% of that notional transacted inside the 150 points between 64,500 and 64,649 - all of it below spot. There is nothing of comparable size above: the nearest meaningful cluster overhead is $30,671 at 65,185.6, 470 points away and itself already consumed during the morning squeeze. The honest counterweight is that realized liquidations are spent fuel in both directions. The longs that would have been forced out between 64,500 and 64,650 are already gone, which means a retest of that shelf has less mechanical selling waiting for it than the last three hours did. What is left is a proven demand zone at 64,500-64,550 where price bounced 196 points in fifteen minutes, and a 65-point gap between spot and the reduce line with almost nothing transacted in it. The next four hours are decided at 64,650: a 1H close under it drops price into the shelf, a hold turns the shelf into a floor.

atr.source: Wilder ATR(14) on the OKX bar=1Dutc series, advanced recursively from the verified prior-completed-bar value of 1,431.52 using the 07 Aug in-progress bar (high 65,388, low 64,159.6, prior close 64,325.8), giving TR = max(65,388 - 64,159.6, |65,388 - 64,325.8|, |64,159.6 - 64,325.8|) = 1,228.4 and ATR = (1,431.52 x 13 + 1,228.4) / 14 = 1,417.01. calibration.note: The morning row backfills to price_next_report 64,715.4, reduce_fired false and add_fired false. REDUCE did not fire: the 64,650 line was never closed under on a 1H basis - the lowest 1H CLOSE since the morning stamp is 64,712.7 on the in-progress 17:00Z bar - although the session low of 64,519.2 at 17:30Z traded 130.8 points THROUGH it intraday, so the level has been touched and defended rather than left alone. Recorded honestly: the morning also recommended a resting stop at 64,620, and that stop WOULD have filled at 17:30Z. The paper wallet was flat futures so nothing was lost, but a stop 400 points under spot and only 30 points under a fresh reduce line was too tight for a 2.19% daily ATR, and this report widens the recommended stop to 64,500, below the session low and below the 64,500-64,549 shelf. ADD did not fire: it required a 4H close above 65,250; the 12:00Z 4H bar reached 65,388 but closed 64,908.9. acting_helped is FALSE - the morning added at 65,020 and price is 304.6 points lower, -0.47%. Two calibration lessons to carry into the endday session. FIRST, this desk has now been on both sides of the same instinct in one week: it lowered an add trigger that then printed, and it held a close-based add condition that then saved it from a false breakout. The difference was requiring a SETTLED bar, and that is the rule worth keeping. SECOND, the desk's stop placement is running tighter than its own ATR: two of the last three recommended stops have sat inside one hour's average range of spot.
